For **GCC pizza chains**, the main alternatives to Turkish halal pepperoni are **beef pepperoni**, **turkey pepperoni**, **chicken-based pepperoni**, and in some menus **sucuk-style sausage** or **beef salami/ham-style toppings** used as pepperoni substitutes.[11][12][14]

The most commonly marketed and operationally relevant options in the GCC are:

- **Beef pepperoni** — widely used in GCC retail and foodservice; Lulu GCC lists Khazan **beef pepperoni**, and several GCC halal suppliers promote beef-based halal pepperoni for pizza use.[10][14][16][17]
- **Turkey pepperoni** — also common in GCC halal product ranges; Lulu KSA lists Khazan **turkey cured slice** and halal food suppliers offer turkey pepperoni as a pizza topping substitute.[11][3][6]
